title: BTC rebound above 83k with lower OI and indicative funding sign flip; ETH 24h divergence
hypothesis: After a sharp deleveraging episode, BTC rebound with falling OI and a change from positive to negative indicative funding may be a short-covering or position-unwind regime, but persistent ETH 24h underperformance can make broad risk-on inference unreliable. Test whether an ETH/breadth/flow confirmation guard improves same-frequency net trade quality over price+OI-only rebound detection.
mechanism: As-of OKX observations: BTC last 83322.7 at 12:08:25 UTC, +1.92% versus Oct 8 19:32 packet and +1.12% versus rolling 24h open; ETH last 2503.36 at 11:57:54 UTC, +1.88% versus Oct 8 19:26 packet but -1.30% versus rolling 24h open. BTC contract OI 2954481.61 at 11:51:11 UTC, -1.96% versus Oct 8 19:25 packet. Current-period indicative BTC funding -0.000025876 at 11:58:09 UTC versus prior packet +0.000032963, while premium remains negative (-0.000537258). These are asynchronous 16h-apart comparisons, not synchronized 4h measurements, and do not prove short liquidations. Reuters Oct 9 reports Brent easing to about $102.60 amid reduced near-term Iran strike fears; no causal timestamp alignment to BTC was established.
exact_rule_or_model_spec: PAPER-ONLY FUNDING_FLIP_BREADTH_GUARD_V1; NOT TRIGGERED BY CURRENT SNAPSHOT. At completed 15m t, require BTC_4h_close_return>=+1%, BTC_contract_OI_4h_change<=-1.5% from timestamp-matched snapshots (each <=5m old, same contract units), indicative_funding_now<0 and indicative_funding_4h_ago>0 for same funding interval; otherwise NO_EDGE. Set BTC_REBOUND_CANDIDATE only, not LONG. Set BROAD_CONFIRMED_REBOUND only if ETH_4h_return-BTC_4h_return>=-0.25 percentage points AND either top50_positive_breadth_share_15m>=0.60 OR independently observed BTC_taker_buy_share_5m>=0.55, with full L2 spread/depth within rolling prior 30d 75th-percentile cost. Otherwise keep broad_crypto=NO_EDGE. Compare BASELINE and price+OI-only to paper-only confidence recalibration and same-side candidate rotation; alternative must preserve side, score>=0.95*baseline, and modeled net edge>=baseline+2bps after actual fees, funding, Q-sized entry walk and 25%-depth-haircut exit walk. Retain baseline when no eligible alternative. No live execution, hard veto, side flip, sizing, routing or production change.
required_data: Point-in-time completed BTC/ETH 15m candles and comparable exchange prices
BTC/ETH OI snapshots at <=5m intervals with observedAt, ingestedAt and contract multiplier
Indicative and settled funding timestamps plus mark-index premium
Independent BTC taker buy/sell flow and top-50 futures breadth
Sequence-validated L2 depth, Q-sized book walks and liquidation events if public
Frozen Superman candidate side/score/notional, fees, funding and paper fills
Polymarket Gamma/CLOB probability histories, spreads, OI and deadlines only when causally matched
transaction_cost_implications: Funding flip changes carry but current-period indicative funding can revise before settlement. Model actual funding schedule, entry/exit fees, Q-sized spread/depth walk, 25% shaved exit-side liquidity, markout, missed-move opportunity cost, and 1.5x/2x slippage; do not infer execution quality from 0.1 USDT top-of-book spread.
expected_benefit: Potentially distinguish BTC-only relief rebounds from broad confirmed recovery and improve net PnL/profit factor/max drawdown and tail shortfall at >=98% trade retention; benefit is unproven.
risks: BTC and ETH/OI/funding snapshots are 11-28 minutes old at packet creation and differ by up to 17 minutes; previous reference is ~16 hours old. OI decline is side-ambiguous, indicative funding is not settled, ETH still negative over rolling 24h, and Binance/OKX cross-exchange OI, taker, liquidations and synchronized Polymarket velocity were not independently verified. Short-covering and macro causation are hypotheses only.
falsification_criteria: REJECT if the funding-flip and breadth interaction does not add incremental predictive/calibration value over price-only, price+OI, funding-only and ETH-relative-only controls; if matched-frequency net PnL, PF or max drawdown do not improve on two locked OOS segments; if retention<98%; if benefit disappears under 1.5x execution costs; if affected 99th-percentile adverse shortfall fails to improve >=10%; or if <5 independent stress clusters support the effect.
validation_plan: As-of usableAt<=decision_time only, completed bars and first-observed funding snapshots; never backfill future OI or news. Develop 2024-25, validate Jan-Jun 2026, locked test Jul-Sep 2026 only if true point-in-time series exist; otherwise collect prospectively instead. Freeze parameters and run >=90 future-only paper days. Compare BASELINE, PRICE_ONLY, PRICE_X_OI, FUNDING_ONLY, PRICE_X_OI_X_FUNDING, ETH_BREADTH_GUARD, FLOW_GUARD, FULL_GUARD, SAME_SIDE_ROTATION and matched-frequency random controls. Report net PnL, PF, max DD, Brier/log loss by horizon, retention, trade count, utilization, MAE/MFE, implementation shortfall, 1.5x/2x costs and event-block bootstrap.
minimum_sample: At least 2000 baseline decisions, 250 rebound/OI-down states, 150 true 4h funding-sign-flip states, 100 breadth/flow-confirmed states, 100 eligible same-side rotations, five independent clusters and >=90 frozen future paper days; extend until met.

primary_drivers: BTC rebound but no fresh completed 15m confirmation
BTC price higher with lower long-gap OI
negative indicative funding may increase squeeze sensitivity
BTC and ETH disagree on 24h returns

contradictions: BTC +1.12% over rolling 24h while ETH -1.30%; broad risk-on unconfirmed.
BTC price higher versus Oct 8 prior packet while OI ~1.96% lower, but side of position closures unknown.
Indicative funding switched from positive to negative while premium remained negative; current-period estimate may revise.
Reported oil relief is not synchronized with crypto prices; Polymarket odds history and order-book quality are missing.
invalidation_triggers: Reduce BTC rebound bias if two completed 15m BTC closes below 81711 and independently observed sell-flow dominates.
Raise BTC rebound confidence only if two completed 15m closes above 83499 with aligned OI/funding, taker buy flow and improving ETH relative strength.
Keep broad crypto NO_EDGE until top50 breadth and ETH 4h relative return corroborate BTC.
Invalidate funding-flip state if as-of snapshots do not show a same-interval positive-to-negative flip over exactly 4h or data age>5m.
